skill.name: AI Work Team Skill
skill.description: Product-engineering team workflows for goal design, implementation, resumable verification, evidence-gated code review, and delivery.

methods.label: Skills marketplace
methods.verify: Run npm test in the installed skill directory when the marketplace exposes the local package path.

agentHints.environmentPolicy: Run Node scripts from the skill root. Core workflows must not require credentials or external services. Reuse project-declared environment adapters, gateways, runners, and resource locks; never infer application identity or build freshness from a port or heartbeat alone. CLI changes must pass Node 18/20/22 behavior tests and the Node 22 mutation gate.
agentHints.deliveryControlPolicy: For new build, bug-fix, and code-review work, use v2.1 to separate explicit task-scoped test selection, catalog health, and execution evidence. Bind acceptance checks to one confirmed contract revision, current invocation, behavior impact scope, environment probes, and current evidence. Review findings require counterevidence, attribution, confidence, and current fix state. Resume only necessary stages; verify and deliver remain read-only with respect to source, tests, and fixtures. Use check-delivery only as a read-only consistency and freshness check; human owners remain responsible for expected behavior and complete impact scope.
agentHints.evaluationPolicy: Evaluate important Skill-rule changes with hidden-answer historical holdout cases before real-task pilots. Compare human active time and escaped regressions within risk groups; critical errors cannot be averaged away and immature observations remain inconclusive.
agentHints.roleActivationPolicy: Treat workflow members as a candidate pool. Before loading role details, record active, consulted, or not_applicable roles with scenario evidence in rolePlan.
agentHints.externalSkillPolicy: Only install external skills from external-skills/catalog.json after explicit user instruction or approval.
agentHints.externalCliPolicy: Only use local CLI capabilities that are registered under external-cli/ and verified in the current user environment.

privacy.policy: Do not store environment-specific, locally downloaded, private, or company-internal skill names in this runtime file.
